scenarios.title: A creature with shadow can be blocked only by creatures with shadow

setup.notes: Dauthi Marauder (3/1 shadow) is attacking B.

decisions: A attacks player B with Dauthi Marauder.
B considers declaring Grizzly Bears as a blocker.

variants.label: nonshadow_blocker
variants.expected: Declaring Grizzly Bears as a blocker is illegal; Grizzly Bears is not a legal blocker.

variants.label: shadow_blocker
variants.delta: B considers declaring its Dauthi Marauder as the blocker instead.
variants.expected: Declaring B's Dauthi Marauder as a blocker is legal.

scenarios.title: A creature with shadow can block only creatures with shadow
decisions: A attacks player B with Grizzly Bears.
B considers declaring its Dauthi Marauder as a blocker.

variants.label: shadow_blocks_nonshadow
variants.expected: Declaring Dauthi Marauder as a blocker of Grizzly Bears is illegal.

variants.label: nonshadow_blocks_nonshadow
variants.delta: B considers declaring Hill Giant as the blocker instead.
variants.expected: Declaring Hill Giant as a blocker of Grizzly Bears is legal.

variants.label: shadow_attacker
variants.delta: A attacks with Dauthi Marauder instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Declaring Dauthi Marauder as a blocker of A's Dauthi Marauder is legal.

scenarios.title: Multiple instances of shadow give the same restriction as one
decisions: A activates Dauthi Embrace ({B}{B}) targeting Dauthi Marauder, tapping both Swamps; it resolves, so Dauthi Marauder has two instances of shadow.
A attacks player B with Dauthi Marauder.
B considers declaring Grizzly Bears as a blocker.

variants.label: two_instances_nonshadow_blocker
variants.expected: Declaring Grizzly Bears as a blocker is illegal.

variants.label: two_instances_shadow_blocker
variants.delta: B considers declaring its Dauthi Marauder (one instance of shadow) as the blocker.
variants.expected: Declaring B's Dauthi Marauder as a blocker is legal; the blocker needs shadow, not two instances.

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: A does not activate Dauthi Embrace; Dauthi Marauder has one instance of shadow.
variants.expected: Declaring Grizzly Bears as a blocker is illegal, as with two instances.
